column5: A number field E that is a totally imaginary quadratic extension of a totally real field E+; complex conjugation is the nontrivial automorphism of E/E+ and is independent of the embedding. Lean: a field with a class CMType fixing the embeddings.
A number field all of whose embeddings into C have real image.
A finite extension of Q.

column1: Finite adele ring of a number field
column5: The restricted product of the completions E_w over the finite places w with respect to the rings of integers O_w; its integral subring is the product of the O_w (written O-hat).
column6: Number field; Place of a global field

column5: The group of units of the adele ring; the finite ideles are the units of the finite adele ring. A finite idele generates a fractional ideal through its valuations.
column6: Finite adele ring of a number field

column5: C_p: the completion of an algebraic closure of Q_p for the unique extension of the p-adic absolute value; it is algebraically closed and complete, with ultrametric norm.
An absolute value with |x+y| <= max(|x|,|y|).
A map of rings preserving 0, 1, sums and products. Used here for arbitrary (not continuous) homomorphisms C -> C_l.
An element z of a field with z^n = 1 for some n >= 1 (an element of finite multiplicative order).
For a nonzero ideal I of the ring of integers O_E, the cardinality of O_E/I; it is multiplicative, and N((g)) = |N_{E/Q}(g)|.
column6: Ring of integers of a number field

column5: A nonzero finitely generated O_E-submodule of E; here also the O-hat-submodule of the finite adeles generated by a finite idele.
column6: Ring of integers of a number field

column5: An element of a discretely valued field of valuation 1, i.e. a generator of the maximal ideal of the valuation ring. Lean uses multiplicative valuations: v = exp(-1).
The inverse of the codifferent {x : Tr(x O_E) in Z}; an integral ideal of O_E. Here E has a generator delta_E of the different that is purely imaginary.

A finite-dimensional vector space over a field with involution (here a CM field E with complex conjugation) with a nondegenerate sesquilinear form <x,y> satisfying <y,x> = conj <x,y>. In Lean a Space is a hermitian matrix J over E together with an adelic frame x with x^* J x = diag(signs) at infinite places and 1 at finite places.
A square matrix y over a ring with involution with y^* y = 1.
A two-dimensional hermitian space with a basis of two isotropic vectors pairing to 1.
A subspace of a hermitian space on which the form vanishes identically; an isotropic frame is a basis of such a subspace, and dual isotropic frames k, l satisfy <k_i,l_j> = delta_ij.

A lattice L in a hermitian (adelic) space equal to its dual {w : psi(<x,w>) = 1 for all x in L} for a fixed additive character psi for which the integral adeles are self-dual; equivalently unimodular.
column6: Hermitian space; Additive character; Finite adele ring of a number field

column5: A continuous homomorphism from the additive group of a locally compact ring (finite adeles, or a finite residue ring) to the unit circle. Its values on a finite ring are roots of unity.
A topological group whose topology is locally compact Hausdorff; it carries a Haar measure.
If a prime p divides the order of a finite group G, then G has an element of order p. Consequence used: a finite group in which every element has order dividing q^n has order dividing a power of q.
The order of a subgroup of a finite group divides the order of the group.
The vector space V (x) W with the universal bilinear map; a pure tensor is an element v (x) w.

For a hermitian space V over a CM field with Weil data (additive character, splitting character upsilon, idele alpha), the representation omega of the adelic unitary group on the space S(V) carrying the Heisenberg representation rho of the adelic Heisenberg group of V, characterised by omega(g) rho(y) omega(g)^-1 = rho(g y); here in a model with a vacuum vector fixed by the standard lattice and the maximal compact at infinity.
column6: Hermitian space; Heisenberg group; Additive character; Hecke character

column5: For a hermitian (symplectic) space W over a locally compact ring, the central extension of W by the circle with law (w,z)(w',z') = (w+w', z z' psi(<w,w'>/2)); its unique irreducible representation with central character psi is the Heisenberg representation.

column1: Mixed model of the Weil representation
column5: The realisation of the Weil representation of a space V = I + V0 + I' (I, I' dual isotropic) on functions of I' with values in the Weil representation of V0; the zero term (constant term) of f is the mean of f(i y + k b) over b in A^p / E^p.

column1: Fock model of the Weil representation
column5: The archimedean model of the Heisenberg/Weil representation on holomorphic functions on a complex vector space square-integrable for a Gaussian measure; polynomials are dense and the vacuum is the constant 1.

The linear form theta on the Weil representation S(V) invariant under the rational points of the Heisenberg and unitary groups (sum over rational points in a Schroedinger model); g -> theta(omega(g) f) is the theta kernel.

For a dual pair U(V) x U(V') acting on S(Hom(V,V')) by the Weil representation (normalised by a pair of splitting characters) and a datum f, the lift of a function z on [U(V')] is g -> integral over [U(V')] of theta(omega(g,h) f) z(h) dh; on definite groups it is a finite class sum on algebraic modular forms.
column6: Weil representation; Theta functional; Automorphic form; Haar measure

column5: A sum over rational points (modulo a subgroup) of translates of a function with prescribed archimedean type and level; here the map from source forms on U(X_0) to forms on U(Y_0) of the data (New.Data.poincare).

The integral of an automorphic form over the Bessel (Fourier-Jacobi) subgroup R = U(X) x unipotent radical attached to a flag/grading, modulo rational points, against a generic character of the unipotent radical times a form on U(X).
The largest connected normal unipotent subgroup of a parabolic subgroup; here the elements whose matrix minus 1 strictly raises the grades of a grading.
A continuous character of the idele class group; here algebraic (type A0) characters of the norm-one adeles with integer weights at infinite places and tame residue characters.
A function on [G] decaying faster than every power of a height function measuring the distance into the cusp.

Here: functions on the adelic points of a unitary group, left invariant under rational points, of a given archimedean type and right invariant under a level; on definite groups, algebraic modular forms in the sense of Gross.
A left invariant Radon measure on a locally compact group; quotient measures on [G] = G(E)\G(A).
A matrix equal to its conjugate transpose.
A subset of a ring closed under the ring operations and containing 1.
A bijective ring homomorphism of a field to itself; here arbitrary automorphisms of C.
A map linear in each of two arguments.
The number of left cosets; 0 if infinite in Lean.
The subgroup fixing a point under a group action.
As in the corpus.
Finite places of E are the nonzero primes of O_E; complex conjugation acts on them.
